newsitem.title: JAPAN: NEC buys LCDs for computers from Hosiden - paper.
newsitem.headline: NEC buys LCDs for computers from Hosiden - paper.

text.p: NEC Corp has started buying liquid crystal displays (LCDs) for notebook-type laptop personal computers from Hosiden Corp, a Japanese business daily said on Tuesday.

The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said NEC has started buying semi-finished 11.3-inch LCDs from Hosiden, which makes finished electronics components and ships them to personal computer makers in Taiwan and other countries.
Hosiden's shipments to NEC would come to several thousand units per month, the paper said.
NEC decided to buy 11.3-inch LCDs from Hosiden as the latter's facilities can make that type of LCD more effectively, the paper said.
Officials at NEC and Hosiden were not immediately available for comment.
Nihon Keizai said Hosiden already sells LCDs to Hitachi Ltd.
